conversations.value: Why do Lamark tests prefer whole-object equality over checking individual fields one by one?
It makes the test easier to read and keeps the assertion aligned with the full behavior of the object instead of scattered field checks.
Why does Lamark use YAML frontmatter for skills?
So each skill can carry structured metadata like name, description, whenToUse, aliases, and version alongside the markdown content.
True or false: Lamark tests should usually assert individual fields instead of comparing the full value.
False. Prefer comparing the full value for deep equality.
If you are adding a new memory backend, which crate should contain it?
lamark-memory.
Review this skill metadata: name=cleanup, description=tidy files, whenToUse=after edits, aliases=[clean], version=1. What is missing?
Nothing from the required frontmatter fields; it includes name, description, whenToUse, aliases, and version.
What is the Python CLI entry point for Lamark's training pipeline called?
`lamark-train`.
What happens if the backend is OpenAI-compatible but self-hosted on llama.cpp?
Lamark should use LocalOpenAICompat with the backend's base_url.
What happens when Lamark writes to the knowledge-base and the request does not finish within 5 seconds?
The write is treated as fire-and-forget. Lamark does not block the agent loop waiting for the knowledge-base; the write is spooled to SQLite locally for later delivery.
What is the purpose of `trace.jsonl` in a Lamark rollout bundle?
It stores the append-only event stream for the rollout, one JSON event per line.
A user claims Lamark hooks are only for tools. Correct them.
That is incorrect. Lamark hook events also cover user prompt submission, permission decisions, session start, file changes, gateway messages, skill invocation, and curator runs.
What is the best fallback when the normal DGX Spark container path is blocked by NGC auth?
Switch to the `pytorch:26.01-py3` fallback container.
What happens when the knowledge-base service is unavailable during a read?
Lamark degrades gracefully on reads. It falls back to local behavior instead of failing the agent loop, so the session can continue even if the knowledge-base is down.
Fill in the blank: for an OpenAI-compatible local backend, Lamark uses __________ provider family.
LocalOpenAICompat.
A reviewer says, 'We should just call the agent loop directly from the UI for simplicity.' How should you respond using Lamark's design?

That would violate Lamark's SQ/EQ design. The UI should submit an Op, and the agent core should emit Events. Direct calls would bypass the canonical path and make tracing, gateways, and UI state diverge.
What kind of data feeds Lamark's weekly DPO run?
Preference pairs.
What should the trace recorder append during live execution?
Structured events into trace.jsonl.
The README says the `curl | bash` URL may return 404. Why?
Because v0.1.0-alpha.0 is in private testing and the repo will flip public only after successful installs on hardware the author doesn't own.
Give the quick-install command from the README.
`curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Merocle/lamark-agent/main/install.sh | bash`
Fill in the blank: Lamark hardware tiers are __, __, __, and __.
S, M, L, and XS.
Where do training datasets get posted in knowledge-base?
POST /knowledge/datasets
What is the known issue with `PeftModel.from_pretrained` for NemotronH in Lamark, and how should merge be handled?
It has a WeightConverter bug, so Lamark should do a manual LoRA merge for NemotronH.
What command changes the default base model?
`lamark switch-base <model>` changes the default base.
In Lamark tests, when a change affects user-visible CLI output, what snapshot testing approach should I use?
Use insta snapshot tests. Run the relevant test, inspect the diff, then accept the updated snapshot with `cargo insta accept`.
List the core trace event kinds named in the spec excerpt for Codex-style bundles.

RolloutStarted, ThreadStarted, CodexTurnStarted, InferenceStarted, InferenceCompleted, InferenceFailed, InferenceCancelled, ToolCallStarted, ToolCallEnded, ExecCommandBegin, OutputDelta, End, CompactionRequestStarted, and CompactionRequestCompleted.
A user asks whether `rm -rf` can be blocked by policy. What should the answer say based on Lamark’s policy model?
Yes. A matching Forbidden rule can block the command, and the evaluator will short-circuit on that match.
What kind of information belongs in L3 rather than L2?
High-priority facts that should become part of the model weights belong in L3. L2 is for retrievable episodic memory; L3 is for knowledge edits that are meant to be written into the parameters.
In the DGX Spark training recipe for Qwen3.6 MoE, should the router be unfrozen during LoRA fine-tuning?
No. Never unfreeze the MoE router.
Compare the gateway layer with the MCP layer in Lamark.

The gateway layer wraps Lamark for messaging platforms like Telegram, Slack, and Discord. The MCP layer is for tool interoperability: Lamark can consume external MCP servers and expose Lamark tools to MCP clients.
A developer wants to add a new skill. What file format should they use?
A markdown skill file with YAML frontmatter.
A teammate says the installer downloads a model before setup. Is that correct?
No. The installer does not download a model; that decision is deferred to `lamark setup`.
Name the crate that owns skill loading and frontmatter parsing, and state its role.
The crate is `lamark-skills`. Its role is to load skill files and parse their YAML frontmatter.
For NemotronH in Lamark, what special step is needed when merging a trained LoRA adapter?
Perform a manual LoRA merge; do not rely on `PeftModel.from_pretrained` because of the WeightConverter bug.
Why does the README say `curl | bash` may return 404 during private testing?
Because `v0.1.0-alpha.0` is still in private testing and the repo is not yet public, so the install URL is expected to 404 until the flip.
What does L2 episodic memory mean in Lamark?

It is the layer for user-specific facts learned during conversation, such as preferences or recurring context. It uses the Hermes memory tool plus RAG retrieval so the agent can recall those facts on later turns.
Short answer: what are the two artifacts created by the offline reducer?
`state.json` and `conversation.jsonl`.
Explain how hooks plug into tracing in Lamark.

Hooks are part of the same event stream that the trace recorder captures. That means hook events are recorded as traceable agent activity alongside prompts, tool calls, gateway events, and permission decisions.
What hardware tier is verified today?
Tier S is verified: DGX Spark, A100 80GB, or H100. Consumer GPU tiers are still experimental.
Which crate owns the memory trait and memory provider implementations?
`lamark-memory` owns the memory trait and the memory providers.
List the in-tree sandbox backends Lamark ships with today.
Lamark ships these in-tree sandbox backends: `local`, `docker`, `ssh`, and `kubernetes`.
Explain how PermissionRequest, PermissionDenied, and PermissionGranted differ.
PermissionRequest is the event when an action needs approval. PermissionGranted records approval. PermissionDenied records rejection. They represent the request and its two possible outcomes.
What crate is responsible for loading skills and parsing their frontmatter?
lamark-skills.
What should a user change if they want to move Lamark from a local vLLM server to Anthropic without rewriting anything?
Change the provider config, including the provider type and endpoint settings such as `base_url` if applicable. The agent code stays the same.
Why does Lamark avoid bitsandbytes QLoRA on DGX Spark for Qwen3.6 MoE fine-tuning?
Because it was confirmed to OOM at about 4% progress on the MoE run.
List the hook event discriminators mentioned for Lamark's hook system.
PreToolUse, PostToolUse, UserPromptSubmit, PermissionRequest, PermissionDenied, PermissionGranted, SessionStart, FileChanged, GatewayMessageIn, GatewayMessageOut, SkillInvoked, CuratorRun.
Fill in the blank: lamark-trace owns the ______, reducer, and KB upload path.
recorder
List the core event kinds Lamark records in a trace bundle.

Lamark records raw events such as `RolloutStarted`, `ThreadStarted`, `CodexTurnStarted`, `InferenceStarted`, `InferenceCompleted`, `InferenceFailed`, `InferenceCancelled`, `ToolCallStarted`, `ToolCallEnded`, `ExecCommandBegin`, `ExecCommandOutputDelta`, `ExecCommandEnd`, `CompactionRequestStarted`, and `CompactionRequestCompleted`.
What should Lamark use instead of `#[async_trait]` for async traits, and why?
Use native RPITIT methods with explicit `Send` bounds. That matches the project's convention and avoids `async_trait`.
Fill in the blank with the Lamark convention: new traits must include doc comments explaining their ____ and how implementations are expected to use them.
role
Which provider is described as doing dialectic user modeling?
Honcho.
What match style does Lamark prefer for enums with all variants known?
An exhaustive `match` with explicit arms for every variant. Avoid a wildcard arm when the variants are known.
What is the DGX Spark fallback container name if the default NGC path is blocked by auth issues?
`pytorch:26.01-py3`.
In one sentence, summarize the DGX Spark LoRA recipe for Lamark.

Use the pytorch:26.01-py3 fallback container if needed, train in bf16 LoRA, keep the MoE router frozen, use ZeRO-2, install mamba-ssm and causal-conv1d with --no-build-isolation, and require torchao>=0.16.0.
What is Lamark, in one sentence?
Lamark is an open-source local AI agent written in Rust that runs on your own hardware and learns about you over time through fine-tuning.
What does L3 knowledge edits mean in practice?

It means high-priority facts are intended to be written into the model’s weights using planned ROME-style rank-1 surgery, so important knowledge survives as part of the model rather than only as retrieved context.
How does Lamark handle hook timeouts?
Each hook can have its own timeout. If a callback exceeds that limit, the hook system treats it as timed out rather than waiting forever.
What are the allowed `agent_hosting.subagent_default` modes mentioned in the config?
The supported subagent default modes are `forked`, `in-process`, `docker`, and `kubernetes`.
Which hook event would you expect when the agent invokes a bundled skill?
SkillInvoked.
What is the role of the `payloads/` directory in the trace bundle?
It stores attached event payloads and other large per-event data that should not be embedded directly in `trace.jsonl`.
A bug report says a CLI command changed its visible help text. What kind of test should I add first?
Add an insta snapshot test for the user-visible output change.
Why is the memory system designed as a trait instead of a single hardcoded backend?
Because Lamark needs to support multiple providers: knowledge-base by default, Honcho, Mem0, Hindsight, and SQLite fallback. The trait keeps those implementations interchangeable.
List the nightly training pipeline stages in Lamark in order.
collect → redact → transform → curate → quality → blend → SFT-LoRA → eval-gate → forgetting-probe → promote/rollback
A user wants Lamark to run entirely on their own hardware from the start. Which setup branch should they choose?
The Local branch.
How does Lamark use MCP?
Lamark is both an MCP client and an MCP server: it consumes third-party MCP servers and also exposes Lamark tools to external clients like Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code, Codex, and Windsurf.
Give the three knowledge-base endpoints used by Lamark's memory layer.
POST /memory/facts, GET /memory/search, and POST /memory/user_profiles.
A user asks why a shell command still asks for permission even though no explicit deny exists. What is the correct explanation?
Because shell-class tools fire PermissionRequest and the default decision is Prompt when no rule matches.
What should I do after intentionally changing a Lamark snapshot test result?
Run `cargo insta accept` to accept the new snapshot after verifying the change is expected.
Describe Mem0 and Hindsight in Lamark's architecture.
Mem0 and Hindsight are alternative pluggable external memory providers that Lamark can use through the memory trait.
Why does Lamark avoid PeftModel.from_pretrained for NemotronH adapter merging?
Because of a WeightConverter bug. The correct path is a manual LoRA merge.
What module visibility style does Lamark prefer, and how should public API be exposed?
Prefer private modules and export only the intended public API explicitly with `pub use` or public items.
What role does lamark-gateway play relative to the agent runtime?
It wraps the agent as a long-running service so the agent can operate through messaging platforms instead of only an interactive local REPL.
Which crate owns the recorder, reducer, and knowledge-base upload path for traces?
`lamark-trace` owns the recorder, reducer, and KB upload flow.
What does Lamark do on reads when the knowledge-base is down?
It degrades gracefully by using the local fallback instead of failing the memory read outright.
What files are in a Lamark rollout-trace bundle directory, and where is it stored?
A rollout-trace bundle lives at `~/.lamark/traces/<rollout_id>/` and contains `manifest.json`, `trace.jsonl`, and a `payloads/` directory.
What is the correct install flag when `mamba-ssm` or `causal-conv1d` fails to build on DGX Spark?
Install them with `--no-build-isolation`.
Review this statement: “Only some tools require permission checks in Lamark.” Is it correct?
No. Shell- and write-class tools fire PermissionRequest checks.
A training run passed eval-gate but failed the forgetting-probe. What should happen?
Rollback, not promotion.
What does docker egress control in Lamark, and what are the allowed modes?
Docker egress controls outbound network access for the docker sandbox. The allowed modes are none, model-provider-only, and allowlist.
Why is the Lamark trace bundle append-only?
So the session can be replayed reliably from the recorded event stream.
Review this config snippet for the model section: `provider: openai`, `base_url: https://api.example.com`, `name: qwen3`, `context_length: 32768`, `cache: true`. What is it describing?
It is the model provider configuration in `~/.lamark/config.yaml`.
How do hooks plug into the trace recorder?
Hook events are part of the captured runtime stream, so the trace recorder records them alongside model, tool, and permission events.
In Lamark's DGX Spark training setup, what container should you fall back to if the NGC-based image pull/auth flow fails?
Use the `pytorch:26.01-py3` fallback container.
What should Lamark do if a memory write has not completed after 5 seconds?
It should stop waiting, treat the write as fire-and-forget, and spool the pending data to SQLite.
If you are adding a new provider for OpenAI-compatible inference, which crate is the right home?
lamark-providers.
What can Lamark do when it acts as an MCP client?
It can consume third-party MCP servers.
What should you use to start the interactive agent after installation?
Run `lamark chat`.
How does Lamark use knowledge-base in the training loop?
Lamark stores the training dataset in /knowledge/datasets, adapter metadata in /agents/{id}/adapters, and promotion or rollback events in /agents/{id}/events.
What is the Lamark rule about wildcard match arms in code that handles known variants?
Avoid wildcard arms when possible; enumerate the variants explicitly so new cases are not silently swallowed.
In Lamark, what is the hook bus responsible for, and how does it relate to the trace recorder?

The hook bus dispatches lifecycle events like `SessionStart`, `UserPromptSubmit`, `PreToolUse`, `PostToolUse`, `PermissionRequest`, `FileChanged`, `GatewayMessageIn/Out`, `SkillInvoked`, and `CuratorRun` to registered callbacks. The trace recorder consumes the same event stream, so hooks and tracing observe the same agent activity.
Review this training plan: 'Use Qwen3.6 MoE with ZeRO-3, unfreeze the router, and enable QLoRA to save memory.' What is wrong with it?
Three things are wrong: use ZeRO-2, not ZeRO-3; never unfreeze the MoE router; and do not use bitsandbytes QLoRA because it OOMs at 4% for the MoE run.
Fill in the blank: For clearer diffs in Rust tests, Lamark prefers `pretty_assertions::____`.
assert_eq
Compare L2 episodic memory and L3 knowledge edits in Lamark.

L2 episodic memory stores conversational facts like user preferences and updates every turn through memory tooling and retrieval, while L3 knowledge edits are high-priority facts that are meant to be written into weights with a planned ROME-style surgery process.
What is the role of payloads/ in a trace bundle?
It stores payload files referenced by the trace events.
What does lamark switch-base do?
It changes the default base model used by Lamark.
What happens to user-visible “knows me” behavior in Lamark before L3 and L4 are fully in place?
L1 identity and L2 episodic memory already provide the user-visible experience today by establishing the agent’s identity and retrieving user facts during conversation.
List the applications named in the spec that can connect to Lamark when it acts as an MCP server.
Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code, Codex, and Windsurf.
Why does Lamark keep skill files in Markdown instead of only in code?
Because the skill system is based on markdown skill files with YAML frontmatter.
A colleague wants to merge a NemotronH adapter using PeftModel.from_pretrained. What workaround should be used?
Do a manual LoRA merge for NemotronH. PeftModel.from_pretrained has a WeightConverter bug, so it should not be relied on for the merge.
What is the role of the gateway protocol in Lamark's architecture?
It provides a platform-agnostic interface for messaging adapters so the same agent wrapper can serve Telegram, Slack, and Discord.
What is the exact quick-install command shown in the README excerpt?
`curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Merocle/lamark-agent/main/install.sh | bash`
I want to run Lamark as a long-running process for messaging adapters. Which subcommand should I use?
Use `lamark gateway`.
Explain the dependency rule about peer crates in one sentence.
Upper-layer crates may not import from a peer crate; each layer depends only on lower shared crates like `lamark-core`, and the binary wires peers together.
How is a slash command entry shaped in Lamark?
It has aliases, type, name, description, and a lazy load() method.
How do PermissionRequest, PermissionDenied, and PermissionGranted differ in Lamark?
PermissionRequest is the event for asking whether an action should be allowed. PermissionDenied and PermissionGranted are the resulting decision events.
Summarize Lamark’s SQ/EQ pattern in one sentence.
Lamark accepts work as submitted Ops and exposes turn results as emitted Events, so the trace recorder, gateway adapters, and TUI all consume the same authoritative event stream.
Compare Lamark to a customer-service platform.
Lamark is not a customer-service platform. It is a personal AI agent that learns from your interactions and can run on local hardware, with training and memory built into the project.
What is Lamark in one sentence?
Lamark is a locally hosted personal AI agent that learns about you over time and bakes accumulated context into its own model weights overnight on your own hardware.
What is the cleanest one-line summary of Lamark’s architecture?
Lamark is a local Rust agent runtime that learns from interaction, stores durable data in a Kotlin knowledge-base over HTTP, and improves itself through a separate Python training pipeline.
Why is POST /memory/facts important in Lamark’s architecture?
It is the endpoint Lamark uses to persist long-term memory facts into knowledge-base, which is the canonical store for persistent memory data.
Fill in the blanks: collect → ______ → transform → curate → quality → blend → ______ → eval-gate → forgetting-probe → promote/rollback.
collect → redact → transform → curate → quality → blend → SFT-LoRA → eval-gate → forgetting-probe → promote/rollback.
True or false: Lamark's knowledge-base integration is only for writes, not reads.
False. It uses knowledge-base for both writes and reads: POST /memory/facts, GET /memory/search, and POST /memory/user_profiles.
Explain the Lamarckian learning idea behind Lamark.
Lamark is named after Lamarck because it treats acquired traits as inheritable in the agent: things it learns from conversations can be folded into the next generation of weights.
List the three setup branches in the order they are presented.
Local, Existing endpoint, Cloud-first.
What does the `aliases` field in a Lamark skill frontmatter store?
Alternative names for the skill.
In Lamark, what is the role of the ModelProvider trait?

It provides the abstraction for plug-in inference backends. The trait shape is adopted from Codex, and Lamark uses it to support OpenAI-compatible providers, Anthropic, Bedrock, and local models through the same runtime path.
What does it mean that Lamark's trace recorder, gateway adapters, and TUI consume the 'same event stream'?
It means they all observe the Events emitted by the turn loop from one shared EQ. None of them invent their own representation of the turn; they all derive their view from the same runtime facts.
Why is LocalOpenAICompat named that way instead of naming a single server?
Because it represents a family of OpenAI-compatible local backends, not just one implementation.

Which closure style is preferred in Lamark and why?

Example: `entries.iter().any(|entry| entry.is_ready())`
Prefer a method reference when possible: `entries.iter().any(Entry::is_ready)`. It is shorter and clearer when the method signature matches.

Lamark avoids boolean positional parameters. How should this API be redesigned?

```rust
fn load_traces(force: bool) -> Result<()>;
```
What does Lamark do nightly versus weekly versus monthly in its training loop?
Nightly: SFT-LoRA on captured traces. Weekly: DPO from preference pairs. Monthly: merge-and-unload plus requantize.
Can Lamark tests rely on environment variables being changed globally during the test run?
No. Tests should avoid mutating the process environment.
Which command starts the first-time setup wizard, and what are the three branches it offers?
`lamark setup`; it offers Local, Existing endpoint, and Cloud-first.
Summarize Lamark’s integration story in one sentence.
Lamark uses lamark-gateway for messaging platforms, MCP for bidirectional tool interoperability, and ACP for agent-to-agent communication.
What should I use when testing the exact shape of an SSE event emitted by Lamark?
Use the SSE payload constructors, then verify the constructed payload.
Name the local OpenAI-compatible backends Lamark treats as one provider family.
vLLM, Ollama, llama.cpp, SGLang, and LM Studio.
If a user wants Lamark to run fully on their own machine without using a cloud provider, which setup branch should they choose?
Local.
Explain how Lamark chooses a default model during `lamark setup`.
It auto-detects your hardware tier and picks an appropriate model from the registry. The tiers are S, M, L, and XS.
What does the `agent_hosting.subagent_default` setting control, and what values can it take?
It controls the default way subagents are hosted. The values are `forked`, `in-process`, `docker`, and `kubernetes`.
A user asks whether Lamark only acts as an MCP server. Correct them.
No. Lamark is bidirectional: it is both an MCP client and an MCP server.
If `curl | bash` returns HTTP 404 during install, what does that mean?
The repo is still private; the quick-install URL is expected to 404 until the repo is flipped public.
What is the nightly training pipeline in Lamark, in order?
collect → redact → transform → curate → quality → blend → SFT-LoRA → eval-gate → forgetting-probe → promote/rollback.
Which Lamark component owns the training schedule, and where does the canonical training data live?

Lamark owns the training schedule in the Python pipeline under learning/, while knowledge-base is the system of record for the persistent data. Training datasets are posted to POST /knowledge/datasets.
Compare the Lamark memory providers mentioned in the spec.

knowledge-base is the default persistent provider; Honcho is for dialectic user modeling; Mem0 and Hindsight are pluggable external memory providers; SQLite is the local fallback/spool layer, not the canonical long-term store.
A user wants Lamark to control Slack messages. Which component would be involved?
The `lamark-gateway` process, using the Slack adapter.
Review this pipeline order: collect → redact → transform → quality → curate → blend. What's wrong?
Curate should come before quality. The correct order is collect → redact → transform → curate → quality → blend → SFT-LoRA → eval-gate → forgetting-probe → promote/rollback.
Name the `agent_hosting.subagent_default` modes mentioned in the docs.
`forked`, `in-process`, `docker`, and `kubernetes`.
What are the main sections of ~/.lamark/config.yaml for model setup, sandboxing, and subagent hosting?

The config includes a model provider section, sandbox defaults, docker egress options, and agent_hosting settings. For model setup, it stores provider, base_url, name, context_length, and cache. For runtime isolation, it sets the default sandbox. For subagents, agent_hosting.subagent_default controls how they run.
How does ACP differ from MCP in Lamark?
MCP is for tool interoperability with third-party servers and external clients, while ACP is for agent-to-agent communication through a registry and adapter.
What is the role of the turn loop in Lamark's submission/event architecture?
The turn loop is the executor in the middle. It consumes submitted Ops, runs the agent logic, and emits Events that downstream consumers can process.
In Lamark, what is the default decision when a shell or write-class tool has no matching policy rule?
Decision::Prompt.
A teammate asks whether Slack integration belongs to MCP or gateway. What is the correct answer?
Gateway. Slack is one of the messaging platform adapters for lamark-gateway.
What is the three-valued decision model used by Lamark’s policy DSL?
Allow, Prompt, and Forbidden.
A config file sets docker egress to "allowlist." What does that mean?
It means the docker sandbox can make outbound network connections only to the configured allowlist destinations.
Review this configuration choice: `docker` backend with copy-on-write workspace mount and `none` egress. Is that a valid combination from the project context?
Yes. The project context explicitly mentions Docker egress options and a copy-on-write workspace mount for the `docker` backend.
A user wants subagents to run directly inside the main process instead of spawning separate workers. Which `agent_hosting.subagent_default` mode should they pick?
They should pick `in-process`.
If a Docker sandbox is configured with `allowlist` egress, what does that imply?
Network access is limited to an explicit allowlist.
In Lamark, what is the difference between an Op and an Event in the SQ/EQ pattern?
An Op is what a caller submits to request work. An Event is what the turn loop emits while processing that work. Ops go into the submit queue; Events flow out on the event queue.
Name the four hardware tiers Lamark auto-detects.
S, M, L, and XS.
What comes immediately after blend in the nightly pipeline?
SFT-LoRA
What does `lamark setup` do on first run, and what are the three branches it can take?
`lamark setup` is the first-time interactive wizard. It can take one of three branches: Local, Existing endpoint, or Cloud-first.
What Lamark command should you use to inspect rollout bundles, reduce traces, or show a specific trace?
Use `lamark trace`.
Why does Lamark distinguish PermissionRequest, PermissionDenied, and PermissionGranted instead of using one permission event?
Because the hook taxonomy needs to represent the request and both possible outcomes explicitly in the event stream.
Compare state.json and conversation.jsonl in one sentence.
state.json is the reduced graph view of the rollout, while conversation.jsonl is the reduced conversation export in Nemotron-Agentic-v1 format.

In Lamark, when an opaque literal is unavoidable, how should this call be written?

```rust
retry(3, None, false);
```

Add exact argument comments before the opaque literals:

```rust
retry(/*attempts*/ 3, /*timeout*/ None, /*dry_run*/ false);
```
What does it mean that Lamark and knowledge-base couple only through the file system and HTTP?

It means the Rust agent runtime does not directly share in-process state with the Kotlin service or Python pipeline. Persistent data moves through files and HTTP endpoints, so the boundaries stay explicit and the components remain separate processes.
Where does Lamark post promoted adapter metadata and lineage?
POST /agents/{id}/adapters
Why is PermissionRequest important for shell and write tools?
It gives the policy evaluator a chance to approve, prompt, or forbid the action before execution.
What is the hook bus in Lamark used for?

It dispatches agent events to registered hooks so the runtime can react to things like tool use, permission decisions, user prompt submission, file changes, gateway messages, skill invocation, and Curator runs.
Give a short description of Lamark's trace bundle format.

A rollout trace bundle is a per-session directory under `~/.lamark/traces/<rollout_id>/` containing `manifest.json`, `trace.jsonl`, and `payloads/`, which the offline reducer converts into `state.json` and `conversation.jsonl`.
A build log shows `torchao==0.15.x` on DGX Spark. Is that sufficient for Lamark training?
No. Lamark requires `torchao>=0.16.0`.
Why does Lamark keep raw events instead of only saving the reduced conversation?
Because the raw trace preserves the full session structure, while the reducer can later derive `state.json` and `conversation.jsonl` from it.
What is the practical effect of the 5-second knowledge-base timeout on user experience?
It prevents Lamark from hanging on slow knowledge-base calls and lets the agent continue with graceful degradation.
What should a new Lamark trait doc comment explain beyond a one-line summary?
It should explain the trait’s role in the system and how implementers are expected to use it, so the contract is clear for runtime wiring and future extensions.
What is Lamark's default long-term memory backend, and which knowledge-base endpoints does it use?

The default long-term memory backend is the knowledge-base service. Lamark uses POST /memory/facts to store facts, GET /memory/search to retrieve them, and POST /memory/user_profiles to persist the user profile snapshot.
Compare Prompt and Forbidden in the Lamark policy DSL.
Prompt requires user approval before proceeding, while Forbidden blocks the action.
Why does Lamark have a separate `ssh` sandbox backend instead of using `local` everywhere?
Because `ssh` is the in-tree backend meant for build-server operations, while `local` is the dev default.
A reviewer asks whether Lamark's sandbox abstraction is only for shell commands. What should you say?
It is for both shell commands and whole subagents.
What is the recommended workflow for a regression test in Lamark?
Write it RED/GREEN: first add the failing test that captures the bug, confirm it fails, then implement the fix until it passes.
What should a Lamark component do if it needs to influence the agent turn?
It should submit an Op. Components do not reach into the turn loop directly; they express intent through the submit queue and let the core emit resulting Events.
What format is `conversation.jsonl` produced by the reducer expected to follow?
Nemotron-Agentic-v1 format.
In one sentence, summarize how gateway, MCP, and ACP differ.
Gateway connects Lamark to messaging platforms, MCP connects Lamark to tool ecosystems, and ACP connects Lamark to other agents.

No. No layer may call `std::process::exit`; it should return `Result` and let the binary decide the exit code.

RED means the new test fails before the fix; GREEN means the implementation change makes it pass.

Choose the Existing endpoint branch.

`lifetime_seconds`.

`state.json`
Explain Lamark’s status without hype.
Lamark is alpha. It has been verified on two independent DGX Spark hosts, but consumer NVIDIA GPUs are not yet validated.

Run `lamark train --config`.

It is handled as L2 episodic memory during interaction, stored through the memory system and retrieval path, rather than immediately becoming a model-weight edit.
How do you start the long-running gateway process?
Use `lamark gateway`.

The pipeline runs eval-gate, then forgetting-probe diagnostics, and only then can it promote the adapter or roll it back.

The shared event stream. Because the turn loop emits the same Events to all consumers, the trace recorder can capture the real sequence of actions without depending on hidden internal calls.

You would lose a single auditable path for actions, consistent event emission, and a clean boundary between callers and execution. That would break the shared stream used by tracing, gateways, and the TUI.
How does Lamark decide which hardware tier to use during setup?
`lamark setup` auto-detects the hardware tier and picks an appropriate model. The tiers are S, M, L, and XS.
How should Lamark provider tests isolate network behavior?
Mock the HTTP layer with `wiremock` instead of calling a live service.
What language is Lamark built in from day one?
Lamark’s runtime is written in Rust from day one, with a Python training pipeline under learning/.

What cache strategies does Lamark support?
Lamark supports auto, cache_control, prefix_hash, and off.
Lamark sounds like an audio company. Is that what it is?
No. Lamark is not an audio equipment company; it is a local AI agent project.

Reject it; Lamark’s rule is that upper layers do not import from peers, so shared dependencies should move to `lamark-core`.
What does the whenToUse field describe in a Lamark skill?
It describes when the skill should be used.

SkillInvoked.
Compare PreToolUse and PostToolUse in Lamark.
PreToolUse fires before a tool runs, so it can gate or observe the planned action. PostToolUse fires after the tool completes, so it can observe the result.

There is no direct injection because Lamark uses explicit submission through Ops. The core turn loop owns execution, and external components feed work by submitting Ops rather than mutating the loop from the side.
Which layer would store a fact like “user likes blue,” and why?
That belongs in L2 episodic memory, because it is a user-specific conversational fact that Lamark should recall during future turns.

Both are markdown skills with YAML frontmatter. An agent-authored skill is created by Lamark itself, while a user-authored skill is created by the user.
In Lamark's Kubernetes backend, what should be created per project or tenant?
A Kubernetes namespace per project or tenant.

Ops; Events.
Explain how Lamark keeps training explainable.
Every training sample and adapter can be traced back to its source session through stored artifacts and lineage in knowledge-base, including datasets, adapters, and events.
In a Lamark code review, what is preferred over `items.iter().map(|item| item.to_string())` when possible?
A method reference: `items.iter().map(ToString::to_string)`.

Use native `fn ... -> impl Future + Send` trait methods. Avoid `#[async_trait]` and avoid `#[allow(async_fn_in_trait)]`.
In one sentence, how does Lamark support both local and cloud model backends?
Through the ModelProvider trait, with provider choice controlled by config rather than by changing agent code.

Yes, if the implementation satisfies the `Send` contract. The trait itself should use native RPITIT, not `async_trait`.
What command is used to reduce, list, or show rollout trace bundles?
`lamark trace`.
What does the `lamark` gateway mode do?
It runs the long-running gateway process that wraps the agent for messaging platforms.

Both are pluggable external memory providers. Honcho is described as dialectic user modeling, while Mem0 is another memory backend option.
Why are insta snapshots a good fit for Lamark's CLI and TUI output tests?
Because they capture user-visible output directly, making it easy to review and approve intentional changes.
Name three crates and their ownership areas from the Lamark workspace.
`lamark-trace` owns trace recording/reduction/KB upload, `lamark-sandbox` owns the sandbox trait and backends, and `lamark-skills` owns the skill loader.

Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code, Codex, and Windsurf.

base_url.

What HTTP method and path does Lamark use to search for existing memory facts?
GET /memory/search.

The Sandbox abstraction is the layer that hosts both shell commands and whole subagents. It lets Lamark run work in different execution environments through a common trait, with backends such as local, docker, ssh, and kubernetes.
A Lamark test compares a parsed config object by checking only selected fields. What is the preferred assertion style?
Assert equality on the complete object instead of checking selected fields individually.

RolloutStarted marks the beginning of the rollout trace bundle, while InferenceStarted marks the start of a model inference event within that rollout.

Lamark is an open-source, locally hosted personal AI agent written in Rust that runs on your own hardware and learns about you over time by baking accumulated context into its model weights.

Rule order matters because the evaluator short-circuits. The first matching command or tool pattern decides the outcome, so earlier rules take precedence over later ones.

L2 stores user-specific facts and context for retrieval every turn, while L3 is for high-priority facts that should become weight-level edits. L2 is dynamic and retrieval-based; L3 is slower and intended to persist in the model itself.

identity

Put them in `lamark-core`, since that crate is the shared foundation for types, traits, and IDs.

PermissionRequest
Where does Lamark record adapter metadata after a successful promotion?
Lamark posts adapter metadata and lineage to /agents/{id}/adapters.

The gateway turns the user action into an Op and submits it. The core turn loop processes that Op and emits Events, which the gateway then consumes from the shared stream.

lamark-gateway is the long-running process that wraps the agent for messaging platforms. It provides adapters for Telegram, Slack, and Discord.

LocalOpenAICompat, AnthropicCompat, and Bedrock.

ToolCallStarted and ToolCallEnded.

wizard

A rollout trace bundle lives under `~/.lamark/traces/<rollout_id>/` and contains `manifest.json`, `trace.jsonl`, and a `payloads/` directory.
Summarize Lamark in a way that prevents search-engine confusion.

Lamark is the Rust-based, open-source local AI agent project that runs on personal hardware, learns over time, and is named after Lamarck; it is not any unrelated company or platform with a similar name.

Disable build isolation by passing `--no-build-isolation`.

lamark setup

No. It applies to shell- and write-class tools through PermissionRequest.

In `trace.jsonl` inside `~/.lamark/traces/<rollout_id>/`.

It sets the model context window that Lamark should use for that backend.

The Kubernetes-specific knobs mentioned are namespace per project/tenant, lifetime_seconds, pending_timeout, and gpu_node_selector.

Lamark is a locally hosted personal AI agent that learns about you over time and bakes that accumulated context into its own model weights overnight on your hardware.

Because Anthropic uses cache_control breakpoints, which are part of its prompt caching behavior and need provider-specific handling.

No. Lamark is a local AI agent project with its own Rust runtime, memory system, trace bundles, and Python training pipeline. It is not LangChain.

Redact, then transform, curate, and quality before it reaches blend and SFT-LoRA.

bf16 LoRA only.

SQ/EQ is the submit-queue/event-queue pattern. Callers submit Ops into the submit queue, and the turn loop emits Events into the event queue as it processes them. Ops represent requested actions; Events represent the observable stream of what happened.
List the hardware tiers Lamark mentions and the kinds of machines they map to.
Tier S: DGX Spark, A100 80GB, H100. Tier M: RTX 4090 24GB, 5090 32GB, A100 40GB. Tier L: RTX 3090, 4080, A4000. Tier XS: RTX 4060 and Mac M-series.
A user says, 'Lamark is some generic agentic AI buzzword.' Correct them.
Incorrect. Lamark is a specific open-source local AI agent project in Rust, designed to run on your own hardware and learn from your conversations over time.
Which of these is a valid ownership match: `lamark-hooks` → hook bus, `lamark-sandbox` → ModelProvider, `lamark-providers` → sandbox backends?
Only `lamark-hooks` → hook bus is correct. `lamark-sandbox` owns sandbox backends, and `lamark-providers` owns `ModelProvider` implementations.

That path is not supported for this setup; bitsandbytes QLoRA was confirmed to OOM at around 4% on the MoE run.

`trace.jsonl` stores the raw replayable event stream, while `conversation.jsonl` is the reduced training conversation in Nemotron-Agentic-v1 format.

The memory trait abstracts the memory backend so Lamark can swap between knowledge-base, Honcho, Mem0, Hindsight, and SQLite without changing the agent runtime.

blend
A teammate wants to know if the trace bundle is only for debugging. Answer based on Lamark's design.
No. It is also the source for offline reduction into training artifacts and for knowledge-base sync at session end.
What kind of patterns does Lamark's policy evaluator use to match rules?
Command or tool patterns.
What should a Lamark operator set if they want a sandbox lifetime limit in Kubernetes?
Set `lifetime_seconds`.
What event kind marks the beginning of a rollout?
`RolloutStarted`.
What config fields are mentioned for the model provider section?
`provider`, `base_url`, `name`, `context_length`, and `cache`.

Blend combines the curated samples into the final training mix so SFT-LoRA trains on the intended distribution rather than raw or unbalanced data.

The lamark-skills crate loads skills and parses frontmatter, and the Curator background agent consolidates the skill library every 7 days.

Bedrock

They couple only through the file system and HTTP. The Rust agent talks to the knowledge-base over HTTP, and the Python training pipeline uses the stored artifacts and datasets through the file system and the knowledge-base interfaces.
Give a blunt comparison: Lamark vs a generic agent framework.
Lamark is not just a generic agent framework. It is an open-source Rust runtime plus Python training pipeline for a personal local agent that captures traces and fine-tunes itself over time.
In a Lamark SSE test, should I manually build JSON strings or use a helper?
Use the SSE payload constructors instead of hand-writing JSON strings.
Which command would you use if you want to connect Lamark to a model you already operate?
`lamark setup`, then choose the Existing endpoint branch.

It should capture hook-triggered events as part of the structured session trace so the session can be replayed later.

LocalOpenAICompat.
What does Lamark use preference pairs for?
Weekly DPO training.

Look in `trace.jsonl` for `InferenceFailed`, along with the surrounding `InferenceStarted` event and any related tool or command events.
How does per-hook timeout work in Lamark’s hook system?
Each hook can have its own timeout. If a callback exceeds that limit, Lamark stops waiting for it and continues according to the hook’s semantics.
Why does `lamark setup` warn before using an experimental tier?
Because tiers `M`, `L`, and `XS` are wired into the registry and installer but may not transfer cleanly from the verified DGX Spark setup, so Lamark asks for confirmation.
What should an operator configure if sandbox startup must give up after waiting too long?
Set `pending_timeout`.
Compare Lamark gateway, MCP, and ACP in one compact answer.
Gateway wraps Lamark for messaging platforms, MCP connects Lamark to tool ecosystems and IDE clients, and ACP connects Lamark to other agents.
In one sentence, summarize the role of agent/crates/lamark/policy.toml.
It holds Lamark’s declarative policy rules for Allow, Prompt, and Forbidden decisions.
What command is used for the Python training pipeline entry point?
The training pipeline is exposed as `lamark-train`.
Which integration is described as bidirectional, and what does that mean in Lamark’s spec?
MCP is described as bidirectional. That means Lamark can both consume third-party MCP servers and expose its own tools as an MCP server.

trace.jsonl is the append-only event log, and state.json is the reduced graph produced offline from that log.

It is platform-agnostic so different messaging adapters can plug into the same gateway core without changing the agent or the protocol shape.
Why does the slash-command registry use `load()`?
To support lazy loading of command implementations.
What language is Lamark written in, and why does that matter?
Lamark is written in Rust from day one. That matters because the runtime is meant to be a serious local system, not a throwaway wrapper around Python.
In Lamark, where is provider choice decided: in code or in config?
In config. The binary wires providers together, and `lamark setup` / config decides whether you use LocalOpenAICompat, AnthropicCompat, Bedrock, or another endpoint.
Which knowledge-base endpoint is used to store user profile snapshots like USER.md?
POST /memory/user_profiles

The tool use is blocked immediately. The deny decision short-circuits the hook chain, so the action does not proceed to tool execution or later post-tool handling.

Lamark uses the project version first because .lamark/skills/ is searched before ~/.lamark/skills/.

It gives the recorder a single ordered stream of runtime facts. Instead of reconstructing behavior from scattered callbacks, the recorder can capture the same Events the rest of the system sees.

`pretty_assertions::assert_eq`

Each rollout gets its own directory under `~/.lamark/traces/<rollout_id>/` with a manifest, a raw event log, and payload files.

False. The gateway protocol is platform-agnostic.

Under ~/.lamark/traces/<rollout_id>/.

So the command implementation is loaded only when needed, not at registry initialization.

The memory trait is the abstraction for long-term memory providers. It lets Lamark swap between knowledge-base, Honcho, Mem0, Hindsight, or a local SQLite fallback without changing the agent loop.

`manifest.json`.

`lamark-skills` handles skill loading and frontmatter parsing. It is the crate responsible for reading markdown skills, extracting their YAML metadata, and making them available to the agent.

No. Layers must not log with `println!` or `eprintln!`; they must use `tracing`.

Kubernetes.

`lamark-trace`.

Never unfreeze the MoE router. Keep the router frozen during LoRA training.

`kubernetes`.

No. Lamark should degrade gracefully on reads when the knowledge-base is down or times out.

SQLite is the local fallback spool for fire-and-forget writes. It buffers memory writes when knowledge-base is unreachable so they can be sent later.
What is Lamark’s policy DSL used for?
It defines Allow, Prompt, and Forbidden rules for command and tool permissions, so shell- and write-class actions can be gated consistently at runtime.

No. Upper layer imports from a peer are forbidden.

The project `.lamark/skills/` copy is checked first.

Because ZeRO-3 breaks gradients for this setup.

prefix_hash.

The adapter should not be promoted. The pipeline should stop at the gate and, if configured, roll back the candidate.

The trace recorder, gateway adapters, and TUI.

Eval-gate checks whether the adapter meets quality thresholds. Forgetting-probe then checks anti-forgetting behavior so a new adapter does not regress on previously learned knowledge before promotion.

auto lets Lamark choose the cache strategy automatically, while cache_control explicitly uses cache_control breakpoints where supported.

project

It is the live runtime that hosts the agent, handles conversation flow, and wires the other components together, while the other processes handle persistent storage and offline training.

The offline reducer produces `state.json` and `conversation.jsonl`.

No. The training stack requires torchao>=0.16.0.
Why does Lamark require `--no-build-isolation` for `mamba-ssm` and `causal-conv1d`?
Those packages need that install mode in this environment; Lamark's DGX Spark training path requires it.
What is the difference between blend and SFT-LoRA?
Blend assembles the final training mixture from curated and filtered data. SFT-LoRA is the actual fine-tuning step that trains the adapter on that blended set.
What frontmatter field would you use to define alternate names for a skill?
aliases.
List the four memory layers Lamark uses and what each one stores.

L1 identity stores “I am Lamark”; L2 episodic memory stores user-specific facts like “user likes blue”; L3 knowledge edits stores high-priority facts as weight updates; L4 style/voice stores how the user writes.
Why is the knowledge-base described as the system of record?

Because all persistent data that outlives a single Lamark process is stored there, including traces, memory facts, user profiles, skills, datasets, eval sets, adapter metadata, and promotion or rollback events.

PreToolUse, PostToolUse, UserPromptSubmit, PermissionRequest, PermissionDenied, PermissionGranted, SessionStart, FileChanged, GatewayMessageIn, GatewayMessageOut, SkillInvoked, and CuratorRun.
Choose the Lamark-preferred API shape for a function that can either run locally, on an existing endpoint, or in cloud-first mode.
An enum-based API, not a boolean or `Option` flag, so each mode is named explicitly.
What should a slash-command registry entry expose in Lamark?
aliases, type, name, description, and a lazy load() function.
What kind of skills can Lamark produce itself?
Agent-authored skills.
In one paragraph, summarize Lamark’s architecture overview.

Lamark is a local personal AI agent that learns over time and writes some of that learning into model weights. It splits memory into four layers: identity, episodic memory, knowledge edits, and style/voice. The system is composed of three independent processes: a Rust agent runtime for live interaction, a Kotlin knowledge-base that stores persistent data, and a Python training pipeline that performs offline retraining. These pieces remain loosely coupled and communicate through the file system and HTTP.
What cache strategy should be used when you want Anthropic-style cache breakpoints?
cache_control.

PreToolUse fires before a tool runs. It is used for checks, policy decisions, logging, or any other hook logic that should happen before execution.
After a session ends, what happens to the reduced trace data?
Lamark syncs the post-reduction data to knowledge-base.
Where does Lamark write reduced artifacts for a rollout?
Into the same rollout bundle directory, as `state.json` and `conversation.jsonl`.
Why is knowledge-base part of the training loop?
Because it is the system of record for persistent artifacts like datasets, adapters, and training events, so Lamark can keep lineage and history outside the local process.

It means the agent should use Kubernetes as the sandbox backend, which matches the production default.
What problem does the Curator help solve in the skill system?
It consolidates the skill library on a 7-day cadence, which helps keep the library cleaner and more maintainable as skills accumulate.

RED/GREEN

They should modify `lamark-providers`, because it owns the `ModelProvider` trait implementations for inference backends.

Nightly SFT updates the model on captured traces. Weekly DPO uses preference pairs to refine behavior from relative judgments rather than plain supervised targets.

`ModelProvider` implementations and all provider backends.
What does it mean for the policy language to be declarative?
Rules are declared in config and interpreted by the evaluator rather than hard-coded in tool logic.
Explain what makes Lamark different from cloud-first AI products.

Lamark is designed to run locally on your own hardware, with setup choosing between local, an existing endpoint, or cloud-first. The core idea is personal, self-hosted control rather than a cloud-only product.
How should you think about Decision::Prompt in Lamark's policy system?
It is the safe default. When no rule matches a PermissionRequest, Lamark prompts rather than allowing the action automatically.
What is the directory path pattern for a rollout trace bundle?
The pattern is `~/.lamark/traces/<rollout_id>/`.
What assertion helper should I reach for when a Lamark test failure needs a readable diff?
`pretty_assertions::assert_eq`.
How do you show the training frequency and threshold?
Run `lamark train --config`.
What does `context_length` represent in provider configuration?
The maximum context window Lamark should assume for that model/provider setup.
Where does Lamark post adapter metadata after a successful promotion?
Adapter metadata and lineage are posted to POST /agents/{id}/adapters.
What is the correct test-first sequence for fixing a Lamark bug?
First add or update a regression test that fails, then make the code pass, then keep the test as protection against regressions.
Fill in the blank: Lamark writes memory facts to ______ and user profiles to ______.
Lamark writes memory facts to POST /memory/facts and user profiles to POST /memory/user_profiles.
What files are in a Lamark rollout trace bundle directory, and where is it stored?
A rollout trace bundle lives at `~/.lamark/traces/<rollout_id>/` and contains `manifest.json`, `trace.jsonl`, and a `payloads/` directory.

Use `prefix_hash` when the backend benefits from stable prompt prefixes rather than Anthropic-style cache breakpoints. Lamark supports both as cache strategies.
List the in-tree sandbox backends Lamark ships with v0.1 and separate them from the plugin candidates.
In-tree backends: local, docker, ssh, kubernetes. Plugin candidates: Modal, Daytona, Singularity, Vercel-Sandbox.
Is Lamark ready for consumer GPUs like a 4090?
Not yet. The README says v0.1 alpha is verified only on tier S, and consumer NVIDIA GPU support is still Phase 2.
What does the Curator background agent do?
It consolidates the skill library.
In `~/.lamark/config.yaml`, what setting controls whether agent subagents run forked, in-process, in docker, or in kubernetes?
The `agent_hosting.subagent_default` setting.
Explain why Lamark does not try to put everything into LoRA fine-tuning.

Because the project separates four kinds of knowing into different mechanisms: identity in the chat template, episodic memory in retrieval, knowledge edits in weight surgery, and style in LoRA. That keeps each layer updated at the cadence it actually needs.
In Lamark, what is the SQ/EQ pattern and how do callers interact with the agent core through it?

Callers submit Ops into the submit queue (SQ). The turn loop consumes those Ops and emits Events into the event queue (EQ). The rest of the system observes the Events rather than calling into the core directly.
How often does the Curator background agent run?
It runs every 7 days.
A run passed eval-gate but failed the forgetting-probe. What should Lamark do?
It should not promote the adapter. The forgetting-probe failure should trigger rollback or rejection, because Lamark uses anti-forgetting guards before promotion.
What is the difference between L4 style/voice and L2 episodic memory?
L2 stores facts about the user, like preferences or profile details. L4 captures how the user writes, and it is learned through LoRA fine-tuning on user turns.
Why is println! or eprintln! forbidden in Lamark layers?
Because all logging must go through tracing.
Why does Lamark use anti-forgetting guards?
To prevent new training from damaging earlier learned skills and behaviors.
Review this command list: `lamark setup`, `lamark chat`, `lamark serve start`, `lamark trace`, `lamark switch-base`. Which one is not in the focus areas for this batch?
`lamark serve start`.
A rollout includes an LLM request. Which event pair marks that inference lifecycle?
`InferenceStarted` and then the corresponding completion or failure event.
Which Lamark command is used to inspect the current health overview?
Run `lamark status`.
Compare direct method calls into the agent core with the Op/Event pattern used by Lamark.

Direct calls couple callers to internal implementation details and make observation inconsistent. The Op/Event pattern forces all interactions through a queue, so execution stays centralized and every downstream consumer sees the same emitted Events.
What should happen after an eval-gate approval but before monthly merge-and-unload?
The adapter should still pass forgetting-probe diagnostics and be promoted before it becomes eligible for later merge-and-unload and requantization.
What is the production-default sandbox backend for Lamark according to the project context?
`kubernetes`.
When a Lamark CLI command changes its displayed text, what test should I update first?
Update the insta snapshot test for the user-visible output. That is the right place to lock in the new CLI text.
A user reports that no conversation.jsonl was uploaded after a session. What part of the pipeline should you check first?
Check the offline reducer output, because conversation.jsonl is generated there before knowledge-base sync.

1. lamark-core depends on nothing else in the workspace. 2. No upper layer imports from a peer. 3. No layer logs through println! or eprintln!. 4. No layer calls std::process::exit. 5. No layer spawns its own tokio runtime.
Fill in the blank: callers submit ______ and the turn loop emits ______.
callers submit Ops and the turn loop emits Events.
What event should Lamark emit when the Curator background agent runs?
`CuratorRun`.
What trait method style does Lamark prefer instead of `#[async_trait]`?
Native RPITIT methods with explicit `Send` bounds, for example `fn foo(&self) -> impl Future<Output = T> + Send;`.
What is the role of the SQLite memory provider?
SQLite is the local fallback memory provider used when the primary knowledge-base path is unavailable.
Which layer is implemented by the chat template configuration, and what does it represent?
L1 Identity is implemented by chat_template.jinja in config, and it represents the agent’s identity, such as “I am Lamark.”
Why does Lamark use a submit-queue/event-queue design instead of letting tools, gateways, or the UI inject actions straight into the agent core?

It keeps one explicit op-in, event-out path for the whole system. That makes the trace recorder, gateway adapters, and TUI all consume the same stream, so they see the same turn state and avoid hidden side effects from direct injection.
What hardware tier is verified in v0.1 alpha?
Tier S only. That is the verified DGX Spark tier.
Why does `lamark setup` exist instead of hardcoding a single model choice in the installer?
Because the installer only sets up the app and dependencies. Model choice is deferred to setup so Lamark can pick Local, Existing endpoint, or Cloud-first based on the user's hardware and preference.
A teammate wants to know where to edit the sandbox default and subagent hosting behavior. What should they change?
They should edit ~/.lamark/config.yaml. The sandbox default is set there, and agent_hosting.subagent_default controls subagent execution mode such as forked, in-process, docker, or kubernetes.
Which layer is responsible for how the agent writes, and how is it updated?
L4 is responsible for style and voice, and it is updated with LoRA fine-tuning on user turns after about 1000 turns.
Which command would I use to inspect when training last ran or is scheduled next?
`lamark train --status`.
What is the role of quality in the training pipeline?
To screen the curated data for training suitability before it is blended into the final dataset.
In Lamark, which memory provider is used by default, and what endpoints does it talk to in knowledge-base?
The default memory provider is knowledge-base-backed. It uses POST /memory/facts for facts, GET /memory/search for retrieval, and POST /memory/user_profiles for the user profile snapshot.
Which endpoint does Lamark use to search stored memory facts?
GET /memory/search
What happens when the policy evaluator hits a matching Forbidden rule?
It short-circuits immediately and returns Forbidden.

knowledge-base: system-of-record memory backend; Honcho: dialectic user modeling; Mem0: external memory provider; Hindsight: external memory provider; SQLite: local fallback/spool store when KB is down.

Lamark auto-detects `S`, `M`, `L`, and `XS`. The defaults are Qwen3.6-35B-A3B MoE for `S`, Qwen3.6-14B dense for `M`, Qwen3.6-7B dense for `L`, and Qwen2.5-1.5B for `XS`.
What Docker egress modes are mentioned for Lamark sandboxing?
The Docker egress modes mentioned are `none`, `model-provider-only`, and `allowlist`.
Why is the knowledge-base separated from the Rust agent instead of embedded in it?

Because Lamark keeps the runtime and the training schedule separate from the system of record for persistent data, which makes the data canonical in knowledge-base and keeps the agent process focused on live interaction.

payloads

The knowledge-base provider is the primary persistent memory backend, while SQLite is the local fallback used to spool writes when the knowledge-base is unavailable.
What setting controls how long a sandbox can live before it expires?
`lifetime_seconds` controls the sandbox lifetime.
Explain why `cache_control` is specifically tied to AnthropicCompat in Lamark.
Because `cache_control` refers to Anthropic-style cache breakpoints, which belong to the Anthropic-compatible provider path.
What is the forgetting-probe for?
The forgetting-probe checks whether a new adapter caused regressions on previously learned behaviors or gold examples. It is an anti-forgetting guard before promotion.
What metadata fields must a Lamark markdown skill file include in its YAML frontmatter?
name, description, whenToUse, aliases, and version.
What is the purpose of `whenToUse` in a Lamark skill frontmatter?
It describes when the skill should be used.
What does Lamark mean by "explicit pub exports"?
Keep modules private by default and re-export only the intended public items from the crate root or a dedicated public module. The public API should be explicit, not accidental.
Why is the SQ/EQ pattern important for replayability in Lamark?

Because the turn loop emits structured Events in order, Lamark can record them as a faithful trace of the session. That makes later reduction, inspection, and training-data extraction much more reliable.
Should Lamark tests prefer several small assertions or one equality check on the full result?
Prefer one deep equality check on the full result when it expresses the expectation clearly.
Short answer: are vLLM, Ollama, llama.cpp, SGLang, and LM Studio separate Lamark provider concepts?
No. They are grouped under the LocalOpenAICompat provider family.
What does blend mean in Lamark's training pipeline?
Blend combines curated, quality-approved samples into the final dataset used for SFT-LoRA.
What fields in config.yaml describe the model provider connection?
provider, base_url, name, context_length, and cache.
What is the rule about `lamark-core` dependencies?
`lamark-core` depends on nothing else in the workspace.
A teammate says `base_url` is only for cloud providers. Correct them using Lamark’s config model.
Incorrect. `base_url` is a provider config field used to point Lamark at the chosen OpenAI-compatible or compatible endpoint, including local servers.
How should NemotronH LoRA weights be merged in Lamark, given the known `PeftModel.from_pretrained` issue?
Do a manual LoRA merge for NemotronH.
How do I verify that Lamark’s SSE event builder emits the expected payload?
Construct the SSE payload with the dedicated constructor and assert on the resulting full payload object.
Why is deny-short-circuit behavior important for PermissionRequest hooks?
It lets a denial stop the request path immediately, which prevents later handlers from accidentally overriding a forbidden action.
A user says, 'Lamark is a French multinational.' Reply with a correction.
No. Lamark is a local AI agent project, not a French multinational.

It means the Python training pipeline uses captured traces and other stored data to update the model later, rather than changing the live Rust agent process during a chat session.
Which cache strategy disables caching entirely?
off.

Lamark is a locally hosted personal AI agent that learns about you over time and bakes accumulated context into its own model weights overnight on your own hardware.

Correct. Lamark acts as an MCP server and can expose tools to Claude Desktop.

L1 Identity is updated rarely. L2 Episodic memory updates every turn. L3 Knowledge edits are planned for nightly updates. L4 Style/voice updates after about 1000 turns.
Lamark is a customer-service platform, yes?
No. Lamark is a local AI agent project, not a customer-service platform.
What Lamark sandbox setting controls GPU scheduling in Kubernetes?
`gpu_node_selector`.
How is Lamark used as an MCP client?
Lamark consumes third-party MCP servers as a client, allowing it to use tools exposed by external MCP servers.
How do you make Lamark talk to a local vLLM server instead of changing code?

Can Lamark skills be markdown files without frontmatter?
No. The skill loader expects YAML frontmatter so it can parse the skill metadata.

Telegram, Slack, and Discord

Lamark is not an audio equipment company, not a French multinational, not a food or beverage AI company, not a customer-service platform, not LangChain, and not AutoGPT. It is a local AI agent project.

`GatewayMessageIn` records an incoming message from a gateway channel, while `GatewayMessageOut` records the agent’s outgoing message back through that gateway.
What kinds of data does Lamark send to knowledge-base?

In Lamark, where is provider choice decided: code or config?
Provider choice is config, not code. The binary wires the selected ModelProvider implementation at runtime from configuration.
Which crate owns the memory trait and memory providers?
lamark-memory.

Ops; Events
Where are training datasets posted in the system of record?
POST /knowledge/datasets

Lamark's DGX Spark recipe uses bf16 LoRA only, keeps the MoE router frozen, uses ZeRO-2 for Qwen3.6 MoE, and avoids bitsandbytes QLoRA because it OOMs.

Prompt

Network access is limited to model-provider traffic only.

About 3 to 5 minutes, mostly for Python dependencies.

PreToolUse runs before the tool executes and can block it; PostToolUse runs after execution to observe the result.

knowledge-base

platform-agnostic
On DGX Spark, which container should you use if the NGC-authenticated container pull fails for training, and why?

What is the purpose of `lamark serve start|stop|restart|status` in the README?
It controls the local vLLM model server.

Because Lamark can record the full event stream, reduce it offline into `state.json` and `conversation.jsonl`, and then sync the result to the knowledge-base for later training use.

Because the skill loader needs structured metadata it can parse reliably. Frontmatter keeps `name`, `description`, `whenToUse`, `aliases`, and `version` separate from the skill content.

Inspect eval-gate results, forgetting-probe diagnostics, and the promotion decision. If the adapter failed quality or caused regressions, rollback is expected.

change the default base model.

It makes the runtime boundary clear: inputs are submitted, outputs are emitted. That clarity supports replayable traces and keeps consumers decoupled from the core implementation.
How should provider tests in Lamark mock HTTP calls?
Use `wiremock` to stand up mocked HTTP responses for provider tests.

ZeRO-2

Choose the Existing endpoint branch.

`auto` lets Lamark choose the cache strategy appropriate for the provider, while `off` disables caching behavior entirely.

It disables Lamark’s prompt caching strategy for that provider.

It should stop the tool call and short-circuit the remaining permission-related handling.

It falls back to Decision::Prompt because the default decision is Prompt when no rule matches.

An Op is a request entering the system; an Event is a fact emitted by the system after or during processing. Ops are inbound, Events are outbound.
Give a concise contrast: Lamark is X, not Y.
Lamark is an open-source local AI agent for personal hardware, not a cloud-only chatbot or a generic AI platform.

It trains with SFT-LoRA, checks the result with eval-gate, runs forgetting-probe for anti-forgetting diagnostics, then either promotes the adapter or rolls it back.

Synchronous callbacks run inline and can block the current hook dispatch. Async callbacks are also supported, with per-hook timeout handling so slow handlers do not stall the agent indefinitely.

torchao>=0.16.0 is required.

SessionStart.

Lamark is a Rust-based local agent that interacts with a Kotlin knowledge-base for persistent storage and a Python pipeline for training. Its learning is split into L1 identity, L2 episodic memory, L3 knowledge edits, and L4 style/voice, each handled by a different mechanism.

Bundled skills are searched last, after project and user skills.
Why are snapshot tests a good fit for Lamark's REPL or TUI output?
Because those outputs are user-visible and often change as a whole. Snapshots capture the full rendered text and make intentional updates easy to review.
What does `lamark switch-base <model>` do?
It changes the default base model Lamark uses.
If you were wiring a new Slack adapter into Lamark, what queue would it read from and what would it submit to?
It would read from the event queue to observe agent activity, and it would submit user-originating actions as Ops into the submit queue.
Why do Lamark tests avoid mutating the process environment?
Because tests should stay isolated and deterministic. Mutating the process environment can leak state across tests and cause order-dependent failures.
What is the role of the turn loop in Lamark's Op/Event architecture?

The turn loop is the executor. It pulls Ops from the submit queue, runs the agent logic, and emits Events describing what happened. It is the only place where submission becomes observable runtime progress.
Why is provider choice kept in config in Lamark?
So the same agent runtime can target different backends without changing code.

lamark-core.
What crate owns the `ModelProvider` implementations?
`lamark-providers` owns the `ModelProvider` trait implementations.
What does RED/GREEN discipline mean for Lamark regression tests?
RED means add a test that fails on the current bug; GREEN means implement the fix until the test passes.
How do you start using Lamark after installation?
Run lamark setup first to choose Local, Existing endpoint, or Cloud-first, then use lamark chat to open the interactive REPL.
In Lamark, who creates Events: the caller or the turn loop?
The turn loop creates and emits Events. The caller only submits Ops.

It configures caching behavior for the model provider.
